# SpotVault

> Quebec marketplace for parking and storage spaces — find a spot near you or list your space to earn.

SpotVault connects seekers with providers of parking and storage spaces across Quebec. Bookings, payments, and messaging are built in.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of SpotVault and how the marketplace works
- [Find a Spot](/find): Unified search for parking and storage with location and distance filters
- [Find Parking](/parking): Browse parking spaces with map view
- [Find Storage](/storage): Browse and compare storage spaces by size, price, and city
- [List Your Space](/list): Provider onboarding to list a parking or storage space

## Optional
- [Sign In](/auth): Account access
